title: 機械系製図Ⅰ
subtitle: Mechanical Drawing I
keywords: Orthographic projection method and drafting 2.Handwritten drafting and CAD 3.Sketch drawing of parts 4.Basics of design and drafting 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the principles of orthographic projection, which is the basis of mechanical drawing. (2) learn the ability to accurately create 2D&3D drawings according to the third angle projection method. (3) practice 2D-CAD&3D-CAD and handwritten drafting to create and edit drawings efficiently.
advice: Mechanical drawings are the most important basic means of communication for mechanical engineers to accurately convey their ideas. Machine drawing information includes not only the shape and dimensions of parts, but also the "dimensional accuracy", "shape accuracy", and "position/posture accuracy" required for each functional form that makes up the part to perform its functions. This course is the first of the design and drafting education courses offered during a three-year period. It teaches the orthographic projection method, which is the basis of mechanical drafting, and the creation of 2D mechanical drawings. We will cover the following topics: 1. Guidance on how to conduct lessons 2. Orthographic projection and 2D&3D drafting, and basic drafting rules for mechanical drawings 3. Hand-drawn mechanical part sketches and complex shape drawing exercises 4. CAD installation, its functions, and drawing creation procedures 5. Size tolerance and fit 6. The role of CAE in manufacturing
books: Textbooks: New JIS mechanical drawing (5th edition) , Morita Kita Publishing (in Japanese) JIS mechanical drawing operation method using Solid Edge ,Kanazawa Institute of Technology (in Japanese) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Lectures are “stacked” learning (work on new subjects is based on the knowledge and abilities acquired in the previous week's class). Therefore, students should review the material in the weekly lectures thoroughly and fully understand it by the next lecture. Reference materials and assignment diagrams used in the class will be distributed using the electronic syllabus of this course. A network printer can be used.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the principles of orthographic projection and express the shape of machine parts.
Be able to understand the basic drafting rules for mechanical drawings and draw drawings.
Be able to draw front, top, and side views of machine parts.
Be able to sketch mechanical parts accurately and create hand-drawn mechanical drawings based on these sketches.
Be able to create machine drawings using 2D-CAD & 3D-CAD figure creation and figure editing functions.
Be able to summarize of the role of CAE in manufacturing by obtaining information related to design and CAD.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately understand the third trigonometric method and basic drafting rules used for machine drafting.(2) Accurately understand the basic line types used in machine drawings and their roles.(3) Select the necessary projections by analyzing the geometric features of parts and determine the main projections appropriately.(4) Sketch machine parts accurately, and create hand-drawings based on the sketches. (5) Understand the size tolerances and surface roughness of machine parts and accurately indicate them in drawings.(6) Gain an understanding of the relationship between design and CAD/CAE, and explain this to a third party by giving a specific example.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Understand the trigonometry and basic drawing rules used to create mechanical drawings. (2) Accurately understand the basic line types used in machine drawings and their roles. (3) Select a necessary projection by analyzing the shape characteristics of a part and determine a main projection.(4) Sketch mechanical parts and make hand-drawn 2D mechanical drawings based on these sketches. (5) Understand the size tolerances of machine parts, the size tolerances of surface roughness products, and the surface roughness, and indicate them in drawings. (6) Gain an understanding of the relationship between design and CAD/CAE, and explain this to a third party in an easy-to-understand manner.

lessons.content: [Guidance on class implementation] 1) Understand the learning objectives, outline, and behavioral goals of the subject based on the distributed learning support plan. In particular, understand which part of the course's learning objectives this class is responsible for, and the specific measure of achievement level. 2) Understand the activity schedule of this course and how to conduct and evaluate exercises. 3) Understand the precautions for taking this course. [Principle of orthographic projection] Learn about the principles of orthographic projection and its application to mechanical drawings.
lessons.operation: Guidance: 1) Understand the relationship between this subject and the learning objectives of the department. 2) Activity schedule for lectures in this course: 1) Sketch limitations 2) Necessity of mechanical drawing 3) Orthographic projection method and third/first angle method
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Preparation for orthographic projection Review: Understand the relationship between the learning objectives of the department and this subject. Homework: 3D shape sketch of bracket Self-inspection

lessons.content: [Handwritten drafting method and sketch of parts] [Preparing to install Solid Edge] Understand the points to note when installing CAD in Part 5. 5) Create a sketch from the three views. 6) Learn the precautions for Solid Edge installation.
lessons.operation: Lectures and exercises: 1) Understand and practice the types of lines and how to write letters and sentences. 2) Understand how to use drafting paper and templates. 3) Try sketching mechanical parts (brackets). Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Homework: Complete exercise (Triangulation drawing of bracket)

lessons.content: [How to create a double-sided projection] Basic drawing rules for machine drawings (1) 1) Understand how to construct double-sided projection diagrams. 2) Understand the line types used in drawings and their meanings. 3) Understand how to select and create essential projections. [Installation of Solid Edge and maintenance of CAD usage environment] 1) Install Solid Edge. 2) Set the frequently used toolbar. 3) Download and set up the template file for the drawing. Self-inspection
lessons.operation: Lectures and exercises: 1) How to create a double- sided projection 2) Line types used in projections and their meanings 3) Selection of essential projections 4) Create three views (front view, plan view, side view) from the floor plan.
lessons.assignments: Homework: 1) Create three views (front view, top view, side view) with reference to the textbook. 2) Compare with the sketch of the machine part you created. 3) Create a sketch from the three views.

lessons.content: [Correcting and redrawing handwritten drafting] Basic drawing rules for machine drawings (2) 1) Instruction on diameter and radius 2) Dimensioning method, etc. [Installation of Solid Edge and maintenance of CAD usage environment] 1) Install Solid Edge. 2) Set the frequently used toolbar. 3) Download and set up the template file for the drawing.
lessons.operation: Exercise: Received corrections for handwritten drafting of brackets and redraws. Enable handwritten drafting according to basic drafting rules (line types, characters, etc.). Self-inspection

lessons.content: [Handwritten drafting drawing] [Basic operation of Solid Edge] 1) Understand how to start and close Solid Edge. 2) Understand how to create and delete simple figures.
lessons.operation: Install Solid Edge: Perform the following operations while referring to the instructions. 1) Installation of Solid Edge package 2) Run error correction program 3) Customization of CAD usage environment 4) Understanding Solid Edge basic operations Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Preparation for “Drawing Procedure Using Solid Edge” Other: Students who do not have access to the campus LAN must take a course on information ethics and complete the network application.

lessons.content: [Solid Edge functions and drawing procedures] 1) Understand the Solid Edge graphic generation function. 2) Understand simple graphic editing functions. 3) Understand the drawing creation procedure.
lessons.operation: Lecture: 1) Basic figure generation function and figure editing function 2) Drawing creation procedure and drawing demonstration -Arrangement position of functional elements based on the center line (a) Sketch of part outline by construction line (b) Part outline design (c) Creating a new projection using existing figures (d) Enter dimensions (e) How to output drawings to a network printer [General exercises]: Creating sketches for assignments: While referring to the explanation of the textbook, ① Basic operation of Solid Edge ② Basic figure generation function ③ Understand the graphic editing function. Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Homework: 1) Complete the task drawing (bracket). 2) Check the graphic generation function and graphic editing function. 3) Check the drawing creation procedure. 4) Compare handwritten drafting with 2D-CAD drafting. Other: For students who cannot use the network printer, install the network printer driver and make it available.

lessons.content: [Practicing drawing of complex figures: Parts drawing]
lessons.operation: Exercise: Create a drawing of a complex figure by hand while referring to the sketch drawing of the drawing task. Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Homework: Drawing outlines of machine parts with complex shapes

lessons.content: [Part drawing exercise: 3D drawing] Review of learning Create a drawing of a complex figure in CAD while referring to the sketch drawing of the drawing task.
lessons.operation: Lectures and exercises: Create a 3D view using a cabinet view. Review what you have learned so far. Create a drawing of a complex figure in CAD while referring to the sketch drawing of the drawing task. Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Review: Review what you have learned and deepen your understanding.

lessons.content: [Intermediate review] Intermediate reflection (orthographic projection, trigonometry, dimension display, etc.) Intermediate confirmation test
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Review and understand what you have learned. Review: Check the written test again.

lessons.content: [Intermediate confirmation test answers, explanations and comprehensive learning] Drafting rules (3) 1) Symmetry figure omission 2) Dimensional arrangement method and its devices
lessons.assignments: Review: Deepen your understanding of what you have learned.

lessons.content: [Size tolerance, fit] Drafting rules (4) 1) Indicated size 2) Upper/lower limit of allowable size 3) Upper/lower limit of tolerance, etc.
lessons.operation: [Lectures and exercises] Size tolerance overview explanation and exercise Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Prepare for a lecture theme. Review: Review the lecture content and complete the assignment.

lessons.content: [Lectures and exercises] Drafting rules (5) 1) Size tolerance 2) Fit (clearance, middle, tight fit) [Regional cooperation] Understand the relationship between design and CAD/CAE by providing information from mechanical engineers at local companies, and summarize the content in a report in an easy-to-understand manner. Create the report with an awareness of the knowledge required to deepen learning in the Department of Mechanical Engineering.
lessons.operation: Lectures and exercises 1) Explanations and exercises on illustrated sizes, tolerances, etc. 2) Explanation and exercises on functional dimensions, non-functional dimensions, and reference dimensions 3) Explanation of IT tolerance, explanation of how to read the tolerance table, and exercises Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Prepare for a lecture theme. Review/Problems: Review the lecture content and complete the assignment.

lessons.content: [Comprehensive power learning] Drafting rules (6) A comprehensive review of previous drafting rules
lessons.operation: [Lectures and exercises] Comprehensive power learning Exercises including dimension and size tolerance Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Review/Problems: Review drawing methods, size tolerances, fit content and entry methods.

lessons.content: [Geometric tolerance, surface roughness] Drafting rules (7) 1) Give an overview of surface roughness. 2) Understand how to fill in drawings. [Achievement confirmation test] Exam: A written test will be conducted to evaluate the students’ understanding of the meaning and application ability of the main concepts of the 1st to 14th lessons.
lessons.operation: Lectures and exercises 1) Explanation and exercise on surface roughness Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Prepare for a lecture theme. Review: Review the lecture content.

lessons.content: [Review of achievement confirmation test] 1) Confirm the concepts that the students’ lack understanding of based on the achievement confirmation test results and deepen accurate understanding. 2) Understand what will be learned in the design and drafting course. [Geometric tolerance] 1) Give an overview of geometric tolerances.
lessons.operation: Lecture 1) Review questions and answers and results of the achievement confirmation test -Explanation of content of the design and drafting course 2) Explanation and practice of geometric tolerances 3) Implementation of class questionnaire Self-inspection
lessons.assignments: Review: Reconfirmation of unacquired items by reviewing achievement test Deepen your understanding of what you have learned up to the 14th session.
